claim: Basis's 2026 Winter Holiday Shopping Trends Report (July 2026) says 83% of shoppers decide on a gift within a few days of discovering it, and 71% use digital tools (search, social, AI) to find gift ideas.
excerpt: Summary: 35% plan to spend more than in 2025 (64% of those cite inflation); 83% decide within a few days or less; consumers want gifts that feel meaningful and smart.
title: One Third of Holiday Shoppers Expect to Spend More on Gifts in 2026, Largely Due to Inflation | Basis
